page.layout: One column of running text with headings and citations set apart. Printed page number and running head at the top right. No margin notes. The left edge carries show-through and the neighbouring page's margin, which are not transcribed. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: similiter Viduam dictam esse, sine duitate. i. societate duo-[?]rum. Saturam seu structuram loci alicujus ex tabulis factis, quae [illegible, ~6 letters]lerentur, & hyeme ponerentur, ædium esse, ait Labeo: perpetui usus paratæ essent, neque ad rem pertinere, [illegible, ~3 letters]rim tollerentur.
main_text.head: 43. Scævola lib. octavo decimo Digestorum.
main_text.p: Scævola respondit: Semper acceptum est, ut Libertorum appel-[illegible, ~5 letters]iam hi contineri intelligantur, qui eodem testamento vel [illegible, ~3 letters]e loco manumitterentur: nisi manifeste, is a quo pete-[illegible, ~1 letter]ontra defuncti voluntatem doceret peti.
main_text.head: 244.[?] Labeo lib. quarto Pithanon a Paulo epitomarum.
main_text.p: Si qua poena est, multa est. Si qua multa est, pœna est. Paulus: [illegible, ~3 letters]ie eorum falsum est. namque harum rerum dissimilitu-[illegible, ~3 letters]quoque apparet: quod De pœna provocatio non est. Si-[illegible, ~1 letter]e enim victus quis est ejus maleficii, cujus pœna est sta-[illegible, ~2 letters]ta ea debetur: At Multæ provocatio est, nec ante debetur, non est provocatum, aut provocator victus est: nec ali-[illegible, ~2 letters]a si is dixit, cui dicere licet. Ex hoc quoque earum rerum [illegible]ndo apparere poterit: quia Poenæ certæ singulorum pec-[illegible]funt: Multæ contra, quia ejus judicis potestas est, quan-[illegible]dic: nisi cum lege est constitutum; quantam dicat.
main_text.head: 245. Pomponius lib. decimo Epistularum.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~3 letters]adfixæ basibus structilibus aut tabulæ religatæ catenis, aut [illegible]tem adfixæ, aut si similiter cohærent lignis, non sunt æ-[illegible, ~2 letters]rnatus enim ædium causa parantur, non quo ædes perfi-[?]n Labeo ait. Prothyrum seu velamen, al. repagulum quod [illegible]s interdum fieri solet, ædium est.
main_text.head: 246. Idem lib. sextodecimo Epistularum.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~2 letters]Labeonum libris pithanon ita scriptum est: Exhibet, qui [illegible, ~3 letters]us, de quo agitur præsentiam: nam etiam qui sistit, præ-[illegible]de quo agitur, præsentiam: nec tamen eum exhibet. Et [illegible, ~2 letters]im aut furiosum aut infantem exhibet, non potest videri [illegible]are præsentiam. Nemo enim ex eo genere præsens satis [illegible, ~2 letters]llari potest. [illegible, ~3 letters]ituit, non tantum qui solum corpus, sed etiam qui om-[illegible, ~2 letters]condicionem quæ reddita causa præstat: & tota al. totius, juris est interpretatio.

p.i: Explicit Tit. D. De Verb. & Rer. signif.

page.notes: Left edge of the page is partly obscured by a strip and show-through from the facing page; words cut off there are marked as illegible and their visible letters are kept. Doubtful readings: "sine duitate" as printed; the faint "rum." at the left of the first line may be show-through; the number "244" and "246" are partly hidden at the left; "Si-" and "perfi-" line-end readings are uncertain. Possible paragraph break before "Labeo ait" was not clear, so it was kept in one paragraph. Long s is written as s throughout.
